Name: Jumping
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod helps you traverse terrain.
[*]It’s perfect as a means of movement.
[*]Using path detection, it prevents jumping to unreasonable areas.
[/list]
[b]How to Use[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] Press the[b][color=#6d9eeb] middle mouse button[/color][/b] (default) to jump to the target location.
[*][b]Controller:[/b] Press the[color=#6d9eeb] [b]left analog stick[/b][/color].
[/list][b]
Configs
[/b][list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Adjust [b]Stamina consumption[/b] to maintain game balance.
[*]Set [b]cooldown time[/b] to control appropriate usage frequency.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29794/29794-1734344062-241715640.gif[/img]

Starting from version 1.0.4, you can enable the “jump into water” option in GMCM.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29794/29794-1753380912-1496451538.gif[/img]

Manifest.Description: This is an interesting movement skill that allows you to quickly traverse terrain without moving into illegal areas, causing bugs, or skipping normal game progression.
